§6Laboratory Glassware§f

§aYour chemical plant before you have a chemical plant. Handy for the early grind.§f

Laboratory Glassware is a hand-held utensil that replaces the Chemical Plant for simple recipes. Two variants: §bNormal§f (Glass + Iron Ingot) and §bBoron§f (Boron Glass + Steel + Cobalt Ingot, higher durability).

Recipes you can make: TNT, C-4, Solid Fuel, Bakelite Powder (Aromatic HC + Petroleum Gas), Engine Lubricant, and Dynamite.

Both variants can be crafted or found in abandoned structures, most commonly §bBunkers§f.

§ePS:§f Invaluable early on when you don't have a Chemical Plant. The Boron variant lasts much longer. Use it for Bakelite powder and solid fuel, two critical mid-game materials.
